title: Economics and Indigenous Nations
description: Introduction to economic theory and policy analysis relevant for Indigenous nations in Canada and elsewhere. Provides basic guidance on principles of conduct for working with Indigenous communities. Based on the approach of two-eyed seeing, develops a normative foundation for policy analysis, addressing issues of efficiency, equity and sustainability.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of ECON 526, ECON 595B (if taken in the same topic).
May be offered as a joint undergraduate and graduate class.
